all.src: Both strikes must have OI >= 100. A violation involving a zero-OI strike is a phantom.

exits.src: MANDATORY ASSIGNMENT GUARD: close the short leg no later than 15:40 ET on expiration day, unconditionally, even though it is covered by the long leg. Assignment would deliver 100 shares and force an exercise of the long leg to unwind, with settlement-timing exposure in between.

MANDATORY ASSIGNMENT GUARD: close the short leg no later than 15:40 ET on expiration day, unconditionally, even though it is covered by the long leg. Assignment would deliver 100 shares and force an exercise of the long leg to unwind, with settlement-timing exposure in between.
If the short leg goes ITM with extrinsic below $0.05 at any time, close the whole spread that session.
Close the short call by 15:00 ET the session before any ex-dividend date if its extrinsic value is below 1.25 x the declared dividend.

unexpressed.text: LEVEL 3 LEGAL: a vertical spread is fully covered within the same multi-leg order, so Alpaca accepts it. This is one of the few genuinely executable arbitrage patterns in the family.
unexpressed.reason: unclassified: no matcher recognised this phrasing

unexpressed.text: MANDATORY: submit as a SINGLE multi-leg order with a limit price. Never leg it — the violation exists for milliseconds and a half-filled spread is a naked short option, which Level 3 will reject on the second leg and which leaves an unintended exposure.
unexpressed.reason: order mechanics: owned by optexec, not by the IR

unexpressed.text: Scan gate: for a call vertical, flag when (K1_call_bid - K2_call_ask) x 100 > (K2 - K1) x 100 + fees + $10. For a put vertical, the symmetric test.
unexpressed.reason: unclassified: no matcher recognised this phrasing

unexpressed.text: Pre-trade checks: both legs' quotes timestamped within 2 seconds, displayed size >= 10 on both, underlying not halted, no OCC contract adjustment on either strike, same expiry and same deliverable.
unexpressed.reason: structural: the template enforces this shape, so there is nothing for a predicate to check

unexpressed.text: Do not chase: one limit order at the arbitrage price, cancel after 3 seconds if unfilled.
unexpressed.reason: order mechanics: owned by optexec, not by the IR

unexpressed.text: Nothing to manage if the violation was real — the position is worth at least zero at every price.
unexpressed.reason: unclassified: no matcher recognised this phrasing

unexpressed.text: If only part of the intended size fills, accept the partial and do not increase the limit price.
unexpressed.reason: order mechanics: owned by optexec, not by the IR

unexpressed.text: If the spread was established at a genuine arbitrage price, it can simply be held to expiry — but the assignment guard below still applies, because the short leg is American and share-settled.
unexpressed.reason: assignment prose: the machine-readable part is the guard, which is compiled separately where the sentence gives a time or a threshold

unexpressed.text: Close the short call by 15:00 ET the session before any ex-dividend date if its extrinsic value is below 1.25 x the declared dividend.
unexpressed.reason: an exit or stop this compiler could not express

unexpressed.text: If both legs finish ITM, close the spread rather than allowing the offsetting exercise and assignment to settle.
